verdict.rationale: Marqeta has extensive documented Core API (cards, transactions, controls, disputes, webhooks) with sandbox, interactive widgets, and simulation endpoints, all publicly documented — clearly a documented public API driving the product. Missing for 10: no discoverable OpenAPI/machine-readable spec (probe 404s) and no llms.txt/docs.md for AI-native consumption, though an MCP server exists for agentic access.
